description: Change the tenant's inventory health policy (see get_inventory_health_settings): health-score weights and days-of-supply bands, the health-degraded alert's drop threshold and lookback, and the target service level and ordering cost used for safety stock and order quantities. Only the fields you pass change; list field names in resetToDefault to put them back on their default. The same rules as the settings page apply (e.g. safe days must exceed critical days). The preview shows each setting before→after and what it moves. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential with Write + planning.execute and the Admin role.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

input.description: The settings to change; omitted fields keep their current value.

criticalDaysOfSupply.description: Days of supply at or below which the stockout factor scores zero. >= 0.

degradationDropThresholdPoints.description: Score points the portfolio must fall before a health-degraded alert fires. In (0, 100].

degradationLookbackDays.description: Days back the degradation alert compares against. 2 to 90.

healthyMaxDaysOfSupply.description: Days of supply at or below which stock is not overstocked. > 0.

highReturnRate.description: Return rate (fraction, e.g. 0.3 for 30%) at which the return factor scores zero. In (0, 1].

orderingCostPerOrder.description: Fixed cost of placing one purchase order, in the account currency, used for order quantities. > 0.

overstockZeroScoreDaysOfSupply.description: Days of supply at or above which the stock-level factor scores zero. Must exceed healthyMaxDaysOfSupply.

safeDaysOfSupply.description: Days of supply at or above which the stockout factor is full. Must exceed criticalDaysOfSupply.

targetServiceLevel.description: Target cycle service level for safety stock: the chance of not running out before the next order arrives, as a fraction (0.95 = 95%). Not the share of units filled. 0.50 to 0.9999.

weightAbc.description: Relative weight of the ABC-class factor, >= 0.

weightDeadStock.description: Relative weight of the dead-stock factor, >= 0.

weightReturnRate.description: Relative weight of the return-rate factor, >= 0.

weightStockLevel.description: Relative weight of the stock-level (overstock) factor, >= 0.

weightStockout.description: Relative weight of the stockout-risk factor, >= 0.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

resetToDefault.description: Field names (as in input, e.g. "targetServiceLevel") to put back on their default.

name: set_inventory_health_settings
title: Set Inventory Health Settings
